application_fee: Fee payable: ₹100 (Rupees One Hundred only). || Women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and Ex-Servicemen (eligible for reservation) are exempted from fee payment. || Fee can be paid only through online modes: BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit card. || Fee payment closes 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs); no other mode of payment is permitted. || Fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable against any other examination. || Application Form Correction Window (08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026) charges: ₹200 for the first correction, ₹500 for the second correction - applicable to all candidates regardless of gender/category.
